findingsNew.title: Only the CLI Code Mode install is documented for ClickUp and Figma, so a Project user is never told how to add or enable either connector
The Figma connector has no setup, enablement or surface statement although Flow Mode Delivery depends on it
Neither connector has a check-that-it-works step with an expected result
No troubleshooting entry covers a missing or disabled connector, and the one ClickUp symptom is written for the CLI
